post1:
Hi everyone, welcome to the Westminster Music Society page!

We're a student-run society for anyone at Westminster who's into music, whatever you study and whatever year you're in. Whether you play, sing, produce, write, DJ or just love listening, you're welcome here.

We started this because music at uni can feel a bit spread out. There are so many talented people around, but it's not always easy to meet them. So the idea is simple: help people find each other, play together and make things together.

What we do:
The Session, live performances every Wednesday at 2pm in Area 51, run by Theo Wargent
A WhatsApp community with groups for different instruments and interests
A musician directory to find people to work with
Socials and meet-ups
Sharing our members' gigs and releases

Who's behind it:
Maximilien Roi, President
Jasper Hazell, Vice-President
Bradley Fletcher, Treasurer
Theo Wargent, The Session host

Membership is free, the link is in our bio. To join the WhatsApp community, just send us a DM.

More posts this week about The Session and the community. See you there!

Every Wednesday, 2 to 3pm in Area 51 (Harrow campus), students take the stage at The Session, run by Theo Wargent. Covers, originals, solo, with the house band or with your own musicians. Here are a few of the people who played on 7 October.

Want to perform? Email Theo (w2145327@westminster.ac.uk) with your name, the song(s) you want to play and how you want to play them. If you're playing with the house band, send the audio and the key of the song. Soundcheck is at 1pm, the show starts at 2pm.

Not performing? Come and watch, it's free and it means a lot to the people on stage.

If you're in these photos and want to be tagged, DM us!

post3:
The society runs a WhatsApp community, with groups for different instruments and interests plus one for questions and suggestions. It's where people find a guitarist for a song, set up jams, share their gigs and releases, and where students from other courses come when they need music for their projects.

Inside, there's a short Google Form. Fill it in with what you do and what you'd like to work on, and you'll appear in our musician directory: a searchable page where members can find a drummer, a producer or a singer and get in touch.

How to get in:
1. Get your free membership (link in bio)
2. Send us a DM and we'll send you the link
3. Fill in the form pinned in the group (with your uni email)
